stem: Jatin must rewrite $5\times(8+3)$ as a sum of products that keeps the same value.

options.text: Write $5\times 8+5\times 3$, multiplying each part of the sum by $5$.
Call the answer a multiple of a sum, and stop there.
Write $5\times 8+3$, so only $8$ is multiplied by $5$.
Treat $5\times 8+5\times 3$ as the starting factored form and $5\times(8+3)$ as the expansion.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The distributive property expands 5×(8+3) as 5×8+5×3, multiplying each part of the sum.

teacher.key_rationale: 5×(8+3) expands to 5×8+5×3. Naming only “multiple of a sum” substitutes a label. Leaving 3 unmultiplied confuses the operation. Swapping which form is the expansion reverses expand/factor.
